author: codex-ai-reviewer-s2
purpose: Independent visual reference proposals for the chronologically selected PRQ 2025-01-03 training acquisition. No claim of human ground truth or model accuracy.
ui_access: Local registered assets and read-only SQLite; no UI review was saved.

selection.selection_basis: Parent states this capture was fixed chronologically before proposal inspection.

first_pass_before_proposal_geometry.prior_exposure: Parent disclosed that fondeo has 14 proposals; no proposal geometry or scores read before this raw pass.
notes: Fourteen distinct elongated vessels seen inside or touching the fondeo polygon, with additional vessels outside the four observation zones.
Several quayside objects need exact contextual comparison; do not treat dock regions as negatives yet.
Automatic observable mask excludes a broad diagonal band and touches two southern fondeo vessels; do not silently override that mask.

method: Inspected the full raw registered RGB previews, every quadrant and all four zone and observable-mask overlays before reading proposal geometries. The existence of 14 fondeo proposals was disclosed beforehand; this is not a fully blinded pass.

Recorded the 14 visible fondeo centers before querying proposal geometries. Matched proposals after that pass and refined each box against raw pixels, without using score as evidence of vessel presence.
Compared the harbor with a georeferenced 2026-09-10 raw preview as context only. Recurrence at a berth is not evidence of permanent infrastructure and does not identify a ship.

Built exact polygon geometry from native pixel edges, the registered affine transform and CRS. Pixel boxes are visual localization windows, with approximately one-pixel boundary uncertainty, not hull segmentations or physical dimensions.

Reviewed scope starts with automatic observable cells intersected with the configured zone and valid data. Explicit, small visual-review extensions retain clear vessels where their windows disagree with the automatic cloud mask; original masks remain unchanged.
Removed ambiguous quay regions from training scope. Candidate negative scope also excludes each positive box and a three-pixel margin. Unknown regions are never converted to absence.
All four observations share one acquisition split group. No family, length or width inferred; no catalog review or label was persisted.
coordinate_convention: Pixel boxes are [xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax] at native pixel edges, upper-left origin, half-open. RGB dimensions are recorded per observation. GeoJSON uses WGS84 longitude, latitude. WGS84 vertices are the exact transform of the chosen pixel-edge corners, not an assertion of subpixel annotation accuracy.
consolidation_notes: All 14 accepted presence proposals are in fondeo. Zero proposals in muelles, canal or patios does not establish absence; specified ambiguous quay strips remain unknown.

V12 extends across the western fondeo boundary. Preserve the full visual box as object evidence and clip review scope to the zone. Its center lies within the zone; a boundary case is not an extra vessel.

V12 and V13 have clear hull pixels marked cloud. V03 and V11 have cloud-mask cells in their localization windows, largely or entirely adjacent water. These are distinct from visual uncertainty and must not silently erase positives from the reference.

The proposed reviewed area includes the small, documented extensions around all four disagreement windows, restricted to valid pixels and zone. A model that removes a visible positive through its own quality filter must face this reference; do not change the reference to match its output.
The image also shows four clear vessels outside all four configured observation zones. They are documented as context only and excluded from the in-zone count and labels.
This AI review requires root consolidation and explicit AI provenance. It must not be relabeled as human review or used to claim independently measured detection accuracy.

context_reference.use: Context only, not a substitute for the 2025 reference.

observations.summary: Sin propuesta ni buque adicional inequívoco en la zona. Las regiones de atraque ambiguas quedan fuera de negativos; la zona completa no puede declararse vacía.

negative_recommendation.claim: No additional unequivocal vessel was found in the proposed negative scope, after removing positives with margins and ambiguous quay regions. This AI visual assessment does not establish small-vessel absence.

uncertainties: Geometrías portuarias provisionales, no demarcación verificada.
Resolución de 10 m; ampliar por vecino más cercano no añade detalle ni garantiza detectar embarcaciones pequeñas o pegadas a muelles.
La revisión tiene procedencia IA y exposición previa al número de propuestas; no es evaluación ciega ni evidencia humana.
Las cajas y las exclusiones son propuestas sujetas a consolidación independiente; no se infieren atributos.
